title: Static option strategies as piecewise-linear cash flows
objectives: Construct funded profits from signed stock, call, put, and cash positions
Derive strategy limits and break-evens from strike partitions rather than memorized diagrams
Prove vertical-spread, butterfly, and box identities and their price restrictions
Separate a calendar position's interim value from a common-expiry terminal payoff
prerequisites: Funded payoff conventions and European parity from chapter 13; bounds and exercise rights from chapter 14.
source_scope: Full English captions for positions 34–36 read sequentially. Dated American dividend inequalities complete the opening source topic; strategy analysis uses explicit European common-expiry assumptions. Original synthetic examples and a computed payoff atlas replace ambiguous premium signs and calendar heuristics.
